source_text: Homo paratus et mundus ducit hircum in desertum. Apostolorum ministerium. Munditia ad mysterium.
pass_a_gloss: Man prepared and clean leads goat into desert. Of-apostles ministry. Cleanness unto mystery.
pass_b_english: A [[prepared, clean man leads the goat into the desert >> Bible:Leviticus 16:21-22]]. Apostolic ministry. Cleanness fits the mystery.
